bio.text: Bob Brooks is the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 7th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.
According to Ballotpedia, he worked as a firefighter in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, from 2005 to 2025 and was elected president of the Pennsylvania Professional Fire Fighters Association in 2021.
His campaign website says he spent 20 years as a Bethlehem firefighter, and Ballotpedia says he started a lawn care and snow removal business in 2013.
